Name: More Dinosaurs for More Animals or Adopt 'n' Skin
Author: livipup
Description:
[center][size=5]﻿More Dinosaurs for More Animals or Adopt 'n' Skin﻿[/size][/center]
[size=4][u]Description[/u][/size]
This mod adds more dinosaur sprites to the game. There are currently two styles of sprites available in seven colours. The sprites are formatted for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2274]More Animals[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n' Skin[/url].

[size=4][u]Style 1 "Vanilla"
[/u][/size][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/4649/4649-1573269482-106500565.png[/img]
The default dinosaur has been slightly desaturated. If you would like the original unedited sprite you will need to unpack the game files and replace the dinosaur_1.png file with the original one.

[size=4][u]Style 2 "No Spikes"
[/u][/size][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/4649/4649-1573272943-1889701897.png[/img]

[size=4][u]Style 3 "Bearded"
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/4649/4649-1573275597-333463819.png[/img]

Style 4 "Long Neck"
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/4649/4649-1573281532-1638040167.png[/img]
Alternate Colours
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/4649/4649-1573286434-2065235351.png[/img]﻿
[/u][/size]These colours replace the standard colours by default. There are sprites for them in all four styles.

[size=4][u]Black and White
[/u][/size][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/4649/4649-1573288399-1639048514.png[/img]
These are additional colours by default. There are sprites for them in all four styles.

[size=4][u]Installation
[/u][/size]To install, open the folder of the mod you are using and drag the contents of the zipped folder into the assets/skins folder. In the image below this will be the highlighted folder. If you wish to install more than one style or remove any of the colours you simply need to remove the sprites you do not want and rename the files accordingly ensuring that there are no numbers skipped.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/4649/4649-1573267193-216605773.png[/img]
